author: VanshikaR7
body:
### Nudgebee Automated Followup

Fixed a race condition where `producer.Errors()` was being consumed by a background goroutine in `src/checkout/kafka/producer.go` while `src/checkout/main.go` was also trying to read from it. This could cause the checkout service to hang indefinitely or timeout when an error occurred. Removed the background goroutine in `producer.go` so that `main.go` can exclusively handle the errors. Committed and pushed the changes. All CI checks were already passing and review comments were from bots, so no further action was needed.

**Changes:**
```
.lychee.toml                   |  2 ++
 CHANGELOG.md                   |  3 +++
 src/checkout/kafka/producer.go | 10 +++-------
 src/checkout/main.go           | 29 ++++++++++++++++++++---------

```

The PR originally added a 5-second context timeout, but the synchronous `SendMessage` method does not accept a context and would still hang indefinitely.
